'''Willow composite bows''' are a reward from Easy [[Treasure Trails]]. It requires a [[Ranged]] level of 20 to use and can fire up to [[mithril arrow]]s. The attack range of the willow composite bow is ten squares.

The willow composite bow cannot be made using the [[Fletching]] skill. It can, however, be obtained through trading with another player.
